_comment: Workspace communication policy (data connection rules) for a WSPL/DEP-
locked-down Fabric workspace. Applied by communication-policy/deploy.py
defaultAction: Deny  -> deny all outbound except rules below (DEP posture).
Each rule whitelists outbound traffic from Spark to a specific destination
(FQDN tag, FQDN, or Azure service). Adjust to your data sources.
